witness_description: Take U=V=R^2, Q(x,y)=x^2+y^2, and the alternating tensor A with matrix [[0,-1],[1,0]].
refutation_explanation: Every element of SO(Q,U)=SO(2) has matrix R(a,b)=[[a,-b],[b,a]] with a^2+b^2=1, and exact symbolic multiplication gives R(a,b)^T A R(a,b)=A. The quarter-turn in SO(2) has no nonzero fixed covector, since its transpose minus the identity has determinant 2. Thus the displayed right-hand side reduces to span{I_Q}=span{I}, while A is not a scalar multiple of I, so A is fixed but omitted.
search_space: All 81 row-major 2x2 integer matrices with entries in {-1,0,1}, in itertools.product order; every candidate was tested symbolically for invariance under the full family R(a,b)=[[a,-b],[b,a]] with a^2+b^2=1, and for being nonzero alternating and outside span{I}.
